description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Zookeeper-based membership table implementation, verifying operations such as initialization, gateway retrieval, insertions, updates, and heartbeat mechanisms using ZooKeeper.

classes.name: ZookeeperMembershipTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ZooKeeper-based membership table in Orleans, covering initialization, gateway management, CRUD operations, and heartbeat functionality.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logging filters for the test class.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of the ZooKeeper-based membership table for testing.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates an instance of the ZooKeeper gateway list provider.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the ZooKeeper connection string if ZooKeeper is reachable.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ZooKeeper_Init
methods.description: Test method placeholder for initializing the ZooKeeper membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ZooKeeper_GetGateways
methods.description: Test method for retrieving the list of gateways from ZooKeeper.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ZooKeeper_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Test method for reading all entries from an empty ZooKeeper membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ZooKeeper_InsertRow
methods.description: Test method for inserting a silo entry into ZooKeeper.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ZooKeeper_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Test method for reading a specific row after insertion.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ZooKeeper_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Test method for reading all entries after insertion.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ZooKeeper_UpdateRow
methods.description: Test method for updating a row in ZooKeeper.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ZooKeeper_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Test method for concurrent updates to ZooKeeper entries.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ZooKeeper_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Test method for heartbeat updates and session management in ZooKeeper.
